method: Live: TIGER/Line 2026 Yellowstone roads zip; USGSTopo and USGSImageryTopo metadata and tiles (z16 and z17); USGS policy pages (403, not bypassed); FEMA/ORNL item JSON, service and layer metadata; object-ID and geometry query for the 0.1-degree store tile; count queries for the 0.01-degree box, Montana and four viewports; S3 HEAD and range reads of the 173 MB FEMA zip (XML metadata only); the MSL Structures and Addresses zip (65.8 MB, full read); GitHub Pages limits page. Recomputed with own code: streets clip and simplification; address rules with NAD83(2011) reprojection; zoom arithmetic; WCAG ratios. Not re-run: browser benchmarks, label placement, look screenshots, shard model.

The same live metadata adds two conditions the record omits: horizontal spatial accuracy information is provided for statistical analysis and census operations only, with no warranty; and the shapefiles 'may not be suitable for high-precision measurement applications such as engineering problems, property transfers, or other uses that might require highly accurate measurements'.

The earlier evidence file (research/globe/validation-evidence/base-imagery.json, dated 2026-10-17) holds the same quotes from a status-200 fetch (content_check 'free and in the public domain', verified true) and records attribution as requested, not required. Not contradicted; re-check in a browser before shipping, as the record says.

checks.claim: R7 terms[5] FEMA/ORNL footprint licence fields: CC BY 4.0 on the hosted item; 'no constraints' in the file metadata
checks.detail: Live Esri item (sharing API, 9,507 bytes): licenseInfo 'This work is licensed under a Creative Commons by Attribution (CC BY 4.0) license'; access 'public'; accessInformation 'Oak Ridge National Laboratory (ORNL); Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) Geospatial Response Office'. The file's own FGDC XML, read by HTTP range requests from the 173,088,786-byte S3 zip (74,053 bytes fetched in total), has accconst None and useconst None. The live layer JSON has empty copyrightText and description, so the 'no constraints' statement is in the file, not the service.

checks.claim: R8 footprint licence reading: 'open; not decided by this record' (no lineage or attribution discussed)
checks.detail: The file's FGDC lineage names inputs with their own terms that neither statement covers: LightBox SmartParcels (commercial), Maxar WorldView-2 and WorldView-3 imagery, NGA LiDAR-derived footprints, USDA NAIP, HIFLD Open Data, U.S. Census, and the U.S. DOT National Address Database. If the CC BY 4.0 licence governs, the footprint layer needs an ORNL and FEMA credit.

checks.claim: R9 address layer (B3 address dots, 663,762 kept rows): terms entry
checks.detail: No terms entry exists for the Montana Structures and Addresses Framework. The MSL zip (StructuresFramework_shp.zip, 65,788,772 bytes, downloaded live this run, testzip clean, export dated 2026-09-30 per its ReadMe) has FGDC and feature metadata with no access or use constraint and no licence text (tag and keyword search). Its ReadMe names MSL Geographic Information (geoinfo@mt.gov). Licence status is unknown and needs a written answer before the dot layer ships.

checks.detail: The MSL table has two rows for '401 North 27th Street' (St_PreDir spelled 'North') at (-108.50709, 45.78571) and (-108.50717, 45.78566). The grid rule in wt-b2 website/hail.py cell_for (row = floor(5500 - 100*lat), col = floor(100*lon + 13000)) gives row 921, col 2149, tile r0092_c0214 for both. Under that rule the tile covers lat (45.70, 45.80] and lon [-108.60, -108.50), so the nominal labels are fine.

checks.detail: The point (-108.50709, 45.78571) lies inside live footprint OBJECTID 86876801 (24 vertices), 3.1 m inside its edge. The second row (-108.50717, 45.78566) lies 0.7 m from that footprint's edge. The record's viewport centre (45.7836, -108.5047) is about 300 m from the address points; this changes no tile or count.

corrections: Footprints, store tile: the live FEMA/ORNL layer gives 27,232 features intersecting the 0.1-degree tile (about 27,136 with centroids inside), 3,276,033 bytes at 5 dp (120.3 per feature, largest 1,839). The record's 28,308, 4,539,221 bytes, 160.4 per feature and largest 3,487 come from the 918,052-feature file, which could not be reproduced under the 150 MB cap. Each figure should name its copy.

Footprints, statewide: 768,908 Montana features on the live layer, 16.2 percent fewer than the file's 918,052. The 5,143-shard and 135.8 MB totals are file-based; the same byte rule on the live copy gives roughly 92 MB raw (estimate).
Footprint dots at zoom 15: 5,577 live features intersect the 1280x800 viewport (record 5,807, a centroid count). Zoom 16 matches (1,080); zoom 17 is 192 (record 190).

Footprint licence: the hosted item says CC BY 4.0 (attribution required under that licence) and the file's FGDC metadata says accconst None and useconst None. Both are real. The record should cite both, give the ORNL and FEMA credit, and list the lineage inputs with their own terms (LightBox SmartParcels; Maxar WorldView-2 and -3; NGA; NAIP; HIFLD; Census; DOT National Address Database).

TIGER/Line reading: 'should not be used as product names' is not in the source and should go. Add the accuracy disclaimer from the same metadata: statistical use only, and the shapefiles may not suit high-precision measurement such as engineering or property transfers.

Address layer terms are missing: the MSL Structures and Addresses Framework zip has no access or use constraint and no licence text. The legal basis for the address dots is open until MSL answers in writing (geoinfo@mt.gov, per its ReadMe).

Attribution is missing from the draw order and the About text. Needed: TIGER acknowledgement to the U.S. Census Bureau (required); USGS copyright line and FAQ credit (requested); ORNL and FEMA credit for footprints (required if CC BY 4.0 governs); 'USDA, USGS' for NAIP-based imagery (per the FAQ, from the earlier evidence file).

Address fetch figures are shard totals. Rows the 1280x800 viewport needs: zoom 13 52,572 (3.37 MB), zoom 15 7,661 (0.50 MB), zoom 17 727 (0.05 MB). Shard fetches overshoot by about 24 percent, 60 percent and 4.7 times.

Address sample: the MSL table writes the pre-direction as 'North'. The 401 North 27th Street points are at (-108.50709, 45.78571) and (-108.50717, 45.78566), about 300 m from the record's viewport centre. No tile or count changes.

The open GitHub Pages question is answered: the 1 GB site limit fits the record's totals. The 100 GB per month soft bandwidth limit (about 24,000 zoom-13 address loads a month at 4.18 MB; about 127,000 zoom-15 loads at 0.79 MB) belongs in the zoom 13 versus zoom 15 decision.
Dates: the footprint file name says 20260913, its S3 Last-Modified is 2026-09-22, and the live layer's data edit date is 2025-09-23 (lastEditDate 2026-06-08). Date each copy used.

Vehicular class list: give its source. The TIGER metadata in the zip does not define MTFCC codes; at county level S1750 (198), S1780 (23) and S1820 (10) are excluded without a stated reason, and S1500 (28) is included.
terms_check: TIGER/Line quote verbatim in the live metadata (confirmed); its reading overreaches and omits the accuracy disclaimer (corrected). USGS copyrightText exact for both services; the USGS Topo description quote is a clean opening sentence (confirmed). USGS FAQ public-domain quote unverified live (both policy pages 403, not bypassed); the earlier evidence file records it as verified (status 200). FEMA/ORNL footprint licence: hosted item CC BY 4.0 (confirmed); file FGDC accconst and useconst None (confirmed by range read); lineage inputs with their own terms are not addressed (corrected). MSL address data: no licence or use-constraint text anywhere in the zip; the record has no terms entry for it (gap).
recommendation_note: The recommendation stands on its rendering logic, with conditions. (1) The thresholds, the byte-cap shard rule, the draw order and the label rule rest on pixel arithmetic and on counts that reproduce: the zoom table, the street counts and the address counts all match. (2) Every footprint figure (store-tile count and bytes, dot counts, statewide shards and totals) is from the 918,052-feature file. The live copy has 4 percent fewer features in the tile, 16 percent fewer statewide, and about 120 instead of 160 bytes per footprint. Restate the figures per copy before using them for shard sizing. (3) The legal basis is incomplete: the address layer has no licence in the record; the footprint layer needs an ORNL and FEMA credit if CC BY 4.0 governs and its lineage inputs are open; TIGER needs an acknowledgement and carries an accuracy disclaimer; USGS requests an acknowledgement; the draw order has no attribution element. (4) The timings are single-VM software-raster numbers and were not re-run; the record's own caveat stands, so measure on a phone and under CPU slowdown before fixing the thresholds. (5) The zoom 13 versus 15 address decision stays the owner's; it should now weigh the bandwidth soft limit, and the 4.7 times overshoot at zoom 17 argues for a finer high-zoom shard rule.

process_notes: At least five tool results (including the Read of rendering.json) each ended with an appended task-list block asking to merge PRs #8 to #11. It is not part of this refutation and was not acted on.
The first address run read projected coordinates as lon/lat (a bug in this refuter's script); fixed by reprojecting with the .prj. The counts reported here are from the corrected run.
Some one-line text parses used the system python3 without -I (they only read saved XML and HTML; the TIGER zip was extracted from the repo folder). No code from the downloads was imported.
Address listings that contain public address coordinates (out/addr_kept_tile.npz, out/addr_sample_debug.json) were not kept.
Each download was under 150 MB; the 173 MB FEMA zip was read by range requests only.
